label: Казаться
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for казаться (to seem, appear).

missions.phrase: Иногда я кажусь себе слишком строгим.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present, reflexive. 'Кажусь' is the я-form of reflexive казаться, ending in -усь. The complement 'строгим' stands in the instrumental case.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present, reflexive. 'Кажешься' shows the -ешься ending. 'Усталым' is instrumental, the case казаться requires for the predicate.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present, reflexive. 'Кажется' is the он/она/оно-form ending in -ется. It is also the common parenthetical for 'it seems'.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present, reflexive. 'Кажемся' shows the мы-form ending -емся. 'Чужими' is plural instrumental, agreeing with the subject 'мы'.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present, reflexive. 'Кажутся' is the они-form ending in -утся. 'Счастливыми' takes the plural instrumental form.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense, reflexive. 'Казался' is the masculine singular past with the reflexive particle -ся. 'Скучным' is instrumental, and 'сначала' frames a first impression.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense, reflexive. 'Казалась' adds the feminine -а before the reflexive -сь. 'Бесконечной' is feminine instrumental, agreeing with 'дорога'.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense, reflexive. 'Казались' is the plural past ending in -и plus -сь. 'Простыми' takes the plural instrumental ending.
Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future, reflexive. 'Будет казаться' joins 'будет' with the infinitive казаться. The verb is imperfective, so the future is always compound.

missions.phrase: Не стоит казаться лучше, чем ты есть.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use, reflexive. 'Стоит' governs the bare infinitive 'казаться'. The phrase warns against seeming better than one really is.
